annotations.title: Events and holidays, with what they are doing to rates

description: Events (trade fairs, concerts, sport, festivals, with venue, expected crowd and whether the crowd flies in), public and school holidays, and news events (a ground stop, a strike, a storm, with what each did to rates) for an airport over a date range. For those inside the 14 pick-up days of this morning's sweep it also gives the lift now: how much dearer their pick-up dates are than comparable days. Also says how much of the airport's overseas visitor base is on holiday at home in that window and whether locals are off. Default: today to 90 days ahead.

airport.description: IATA airport code, e.g. AKL, SYD, LHR, MAD. See list_airports.
